$comment: Agent notes for stickers, sticker sets and custom emoji sets. Shape and rules: scripts/api_notes.py. Every pitfall carries its source label; API means the catalog text quoted in cite, Official a core.telegram.org page (URL in cite).

sendSticker.purpose: Send one sticker (static .WEBP, animated .TGS or video .WEBM) to a chat.
use_when: re-sending a sticker whose file_id the bot already has (the catalog's recommended way)
avoid_when: a custom emoji inside text: use a custom_emoji entity, not a separate sticker message

pitfalls.text: An HTTP URL works for .WEBP only; animated and video stickers need a file_id or an upload.
pitfalls.cite: sticker: Video and animated stickers can't be sent via an HTTP URL.

pitfalls.text: emoji applies to just uploaded stickers only.
pitfalls.cite: emoji: Emoji associated with the sticker; only for just uploaded stickers

getStickerSet.purpose: Read a sticker set by name: its type, title and every Sticker with file_id and custom_emoji_id.
use_when: you need real custom_emoji_id values and each emoji's Unicode fallback
reading back a set the bot just created or changed
avoid_when: you hold only some ids: getCustomEmojiStickers resolves up to 200 of them

pitfalls.text: name is the set's short name (the t.me link part), not its title.
pitfalls.cite: createNewStickerSet name: Short name of sticker set, to be used in t.me/addstickers/ URLs

pitfalls.text: custom_emoji_id exists only on custom emoji stickers; the edit methods take a file_id.
pitfalls.cite: Sticker custom_emoji_id: For custom emoji stickers, unique identifier of the custom emoji

pitfalls.text: Use Sticker.emoji as the fallback emoji of a custom emoji in text.
pitfalls.cite: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#html-style: It is recommended to use the emoji from the emoji field of the custom emoji sticker.

pitfalls.text: Never invent an id: take it from here, a custom_emoji entity or getCustomEmojiStickers.

getCustomEmojiStickers.purpose: Resolve custom emoji ids to Sticker objects (emoji, set_name, animated or video flags).
use_when: verifying an id you were given before shipping it
finding the set of an id captured from a custom_emoji entity
avoid_when: you know the set name: getStickerSet returns every id of it at once

pitfalls.text: At most 200 ids per call; send longer lists in chunks.
pitfalls.cite: custom_emoji_ids: At most 200 custom emoji identifiers can be specified.

pitfalls.text: MessageEntity points here for the full information about a custom emoji.
pitfalls.cite: MessageEntity custom_emoji_id: Use getCustomEmojiStickers to get full information about the sticker.

pitfalls.text: What an unknown id returns (an error or a shorter array) is not documented; compare the ids you get back with the ids you sent.

uploadStickerFile.purpose: Upload a sticker file once for later use in createNewStickerSet, addStickerToSet or replaceStickerInSet.
use_when: a new file must enter a set and you want a reusable file_id first
avoid_when: the sticker already has a file_id or, for .WEBP, an HTTP URL: InputSticker.sticker takes those directly

pitfalls.text: sticker_format is required: static, animated or video.
pitfalls.cite: sticker_format: Format of the sticker, must be one of “static”, “animated”, “video”

pitfalls.text: The returned File's file_id goes into InputSticker.sticker; the file can be used several times.
pitfalls.cite: uploadStickerFile: Returns the uploaded File on success; InputSticker sticker: Pass a file_id as a String

pitfalls.text: Size and duration limits are not in the method text: emoji images are exactly 100x100 px (PNG or WEBP), static stickers need one side of exactly 512 px.
pitfalls.cite: https://core.telegram.org/stickers

createNewStickerSet.purpose: Create a sticker set owned by a user; the bot can then edit it. sticker_type picks regular, mask or custom_emoji.
use_when: the bot publishes its own sticker or custom emoji pack for an owner user_id
avoid_when: you only need ids of an existing set: getStickerSet

pitfalls.text: name: letters, digits, underscores; starts with a letter; no double underscore; ends in _by_<bot_username>; 1-64 characters.
pitfalls.cite: name: must end in "_by_<bot_username>". <bot_username> is case insensitive. 1-64 characters.

pitfalls.text: stickers holds 1-50 InputSticker; each needs format and emoji_list (1-20 emoji).
pitfalls.cite: stickers: A JSON-serialized list of 1-50 initial stickers; InputSticker emoji_list: List of 1-20 emoji

pitfalls.text: Regular by default; needs_repainting applies to custom emoji sets only.
pitfalls.cite: sticker_type: By default, a regular sticker set is created.; needs_repainting: ... for custom emoji sticker sets only

pitfalls.text: It returns True, not the set: call getStickerSet to read file_ids and custom_emoji_ids.
pitfalls.cite: createNewStickerSet: Returns True on success.

pitfalls.text: Whether the owner must have started the bot first is not stated.

addStickerToSet.purpose: Add one sticker to a set the bot created.
use_when: growing a set after createNewStickerSet, one InputSticker per call
avoid_when: swapping a sticker: replaceStickerInSet does delete, add and position in one call

pitfalls.text: An emoji set holds up to 200 stickers, any other set up to 120.
pitfalls.cite: addStickerToSet: Emoji sticker sets can have up to 200 stickers. Other sticker sets can have up to 120 stickers.

pitfalls.text: An exactly identical sticker leaves the set unchanged.
pitfalls.cite: sticker: If exactly the same sticker had already been added to the set, then the set isn't changed.

pitfalls.text: sticker is one InputSticker object, not a list.
pitfalls.cite: sticker: A JSON-serialized object with information about the added sticker.

setStickerPositionInSet.purpose: Move a sticker of a bot-created set to a zero-based position.
use_when: reordering a set after reading its current order with getStickerSet

pitfalls.text: sticker is a file_id string; file_unique_id cannot be used to reuse a file.
pitfalls.cite: Sticker file_unique_id: Can't be used to download or reuse the file.

pitfalls.text: position is zero-based.
pitfalls.cite: position: New sticker position in the set, zero-based

pitfalls.text: The result for a position past the last sticker is not documented.

deleteStickerFromSet.purpose: Delete one sticker from a set created by the bot.
use_when: removing a single sticker the owner asked to drop

pitfalls.text: It takes only the sticker's file_id; read it from getStickerSet first.
pitfalls.cite: sticker: File identifier of the sticker

pitfalls.text: replaceStickerInSet is the same as deleting, adding and repositioning.
pitfalls.cite: replaceStickerInSet: equivalent to calling deleteStickerFromSet, then addStickerToSet, then setStickerPositionInSet

pitfalls.text: Destructive: confirm with the owner before the call and do not repeat it in a retry loop.
Deleting the last sticker of a set is not described.

replaceStickerInSet.purpose: Replace one sticker of a set with a new one in a single call (delete, add, set position).
use_when: updating the artwork of a sticker while keeping its place in the set

pitfalls.text: It is equivalent to deleteStickerFromSet, addStickerToSet and setStickerPositionInSet in a row.
pitfalls.cite: replaceStickerInSet: equivalent to calling deleteStickerFromSet, then addStickerToSet, then setStickerPositionInSet

pitfalls.text: old_sticker is a file_id; sticker is an InputSticker object.
pitfalls.cite: old_sticker: File identifier of the replaced sticker

pitfalls.text: An exactly identical new sticker leaves the set unchanged.
pitfalls.cite: sticker: If exactly the same sticker had already been added to the set, then the set remains unchanged.

pitfalls.text: Destructive: the old sticker is removed; confirm first.

setStickerEmojiList.purpose: Change the emoji list of a regular or custom emoji sticker in a bot-created set.
use_when: fixing the emoji an emoji pack sticker is found and sent with
avoid_when: a mask sticker: this method names regular and custom emoji stickers only

pitfalls.text: emoji_list holds 1-20 emoji, so it can never be empty.
pitfalls.cite: emoji_list: A JSON-serialized list of 1-20 emoji associated with the sticker

pitfalls.text: The sticker must belong to a set created by the bot; pass its file_id.
pitfalls.cite: setStickerEmojiList: The sticker must belong to a sticker set created by the bot.

setStickerKeywords.purpose: Change the search keywords of a regular or custom emoji sticker in a bot-created set.
use_when: making stickers findable by words, not only by emoji

pitfalls.text: 0-20 keywords with 64 characters in total, not 64 each.
pitfalls.cite: keywords: A JSON-serialized list of 0-20 search keywords for the sticker with total length of up to 64 characters

pitfalls.text: Mask stickers take no keywords.
pitfalls.cite: InputSticker keywords: For “regular” and “custom_emoji” stickers only.

pitfalls.text: What omitting keywords does is not stated; send an explicit list.

setStickerMaskPosition.purpose: Change where a mask sticker sits on a face, or remove its mask position.
use_when: adjusting a mask sticker of a set created by the bot
avoid_when: regular and custom emoji stickers: they have no mask position

pitfalls.text: Omit mask_position to remove it.
pitfalls.cite: mask_position: Omit the parameter to remove the mask position.

pitfalls.text: MaskPosition needs all four fields: point (forehead, eyes, mouth or chin), x_shift, y_shift and scale.
pitfalls.cite: MaskPosition point: One of “forehead”, “eyes”, “mouth”, or “chin”.

setStickerSetTitle.purpose: Change the title of a created sticker set; name identifies the set and stays as it is.

pitfalls.text: title is 1-64 characters.
pitfalls.cite: title: Sticker set title, 1-64 characters

pitfalls.text: name is the short name that selects the set, not a new title.
pitfalls.cite: name: Sticker set name

setStickerSetThumbnail.purpose: Set or drop the thumbnail of a regular or mask sticker set.
avoid_when: a custom emoji set: use setCustomEmojiStickerSetThumbnail

pitfalls.text: format is required and the file must match the stickers' format: static (.WEBP or .PNG), animated (.TGS), video (.WEBM).
pitfalls.cite: thumbnail: The format of the thumbnail file must match the format of the stickers in the set.

pitfalls.text: A static thumbnail is up to 128 KB and exactly 100x100 px; animated and video ones up to 32 KB.
pitfalls.cite: thumbnail: must be up to 128 kilobytes in size and have a width and height of exactly 100px

pitfalls.text: Omit thumbnail to drop it; the first sticker is shown instead.
pitfalls.cite: thumbnail: If omitted, then the thumbnail is dropped and the first sticker is used as the thumbnail.

setCustomEmojiStickerSetThumbnail.purpose: Pick one emoji of a custom emoji set as the set's thumbnail, or drop the thumbnail with an empty string.
use_when: finishing a new custom emoji pack: use an id read from getStickerSet
avoid_when: a regular or mask set: use setStickerSetThumbnail

pitfalls.text: It takes a custom_emoji_id of a sticker in that set, not a file_id or an uploaded image.
pitfalls.cite: custom_emoji_id: Custom emoji identifier of a sticker from the sticker set

pitfalls.text: An empty string drops the thumbnail; the first sticker is used instead.
pitfalls.cite: custom_emoji_id: pass an empty string to drop the thumbnail and use the first sticker as the thumbnail

deleteStickerSet.purpose: Delete a whole sticker set that the bot created.
use_when: the owner asked to remove the entire pack

pitfalls.text: Only a set created by the bot can be deleted.
pitfalls.cite: deleteStickerSet: delete a sticker set that was created by the bot

pitfalls.text: Destructive: confirm with the owner first; the examples record this call, they never send it.
